verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the title of BigCommerce's 'Omnichannel Ecommerce Software Solution' page. It implies selling across channels from the platform, but gives no detail on how products are listed or synced to external channels. Missing for 10: documented integrations with specific marketplaces (e.g., Amazon, eBay), social commerce channels, and shopping feeds; evidence of single-catalog sync behavior (inventory, pricing, listing updates); and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
